jobs.description:
Summary

As Product Management Excellence Manager, you play a key role in strengthening and advancing Product Management at Belimo. You drive capability building, establish best-in-class practices, and provide the frameworks, tools, and insights that enable Product Managers to succeed throughout the entire product lifecycle. Working closely with Product Managers and senior leaders, you help shape the future of Product Management and contribute directly to Belimo’s long-term growth and innovation.

What You'll Do

• Own and continuously develop Belimo’s global Product Management training program, ensuring measurable capability growth and business impact across the organization.

• Design, implement, and optimize training curricula, learning formats, and coaching approaches in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Mentor and coach Product Managers, acting as a trusted sparring partner and supporting critical business situations.

• Drive the evolution and standardization of Product Management processes, methodologies, templates, and tools to increase efficiency, consistency, and quality.

• Establish and further develop KPI frameworks, analytics, and reporting structures that enable data-driven portfolio and lifecycle management decisions.

• Analyze portfolio performance, market developments, and lifecycle data to identify opportunities, risks, and improvement areas.

• Support strategic Product Management initiatives and contribute to the continuous evolution of the Group Product Management function.

Who You Are

• Formal education in Product Management or a related discipline, complemented by extensive practical experience in the field.

• Proven track record in Product Management and Product Leadership roles within industrial, B2B, electronics, HVAC, or comparable environments, with broad exposure across the product lifecycle.

• Strong understanding of both hardware and software products and the challenges of managing products throughout their lifecycle.

• Proven experience leading organizational change, driving adoption, and successfully implementing new standards, processes, and ways of working.

• Passion for developing people, building organizational capabilities, and coaching others to achieve sustainable success.

• Analytical and systems-thinking mindset combined with a pragmatic, execution-oriented approach and the ability to translate concepts into action.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi

In qualità di Product Management Excellence Manager, si gioca un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare e promuovere la gestione dei prodotti a Belimo. Guidare la costruzione delle capacità, stabilire le pratiche migliori in classe, e fornire i quadri, gli strumenti e le intuizioni che consentono ai Product Manager di avere successo durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Product Manager e senior leader, aiuta a plasmare il futuro della Product Management e a contribuire direttamente alla crescita e all’innovazione a lungo termine di Belimo.

Cosa farai

• Promuovere e sviluppare continuamente il programma di formazione globale di Belimo Product Management, garantendo una crescita delle capacità misurabile e un impatto aziendale in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Progettazione, implementazione e ottimizzazione curricula di formazione, formati di apprendimento e approcci di coaching in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni e partner esterni.

• Mentor e coach Product Managers, che agisce come partner di risparmio affidabile e supporta situazioni di business critiche.

• Guidare l'evoluzione e la standardizzazione dei processi di gestione dei prodotti, metodologie, modelli e strumenti per aumentare l'efficienza, la coerenza e la qualità.

• Stabilire e sviluppare ulteriormente i framework KPI, le strutture di analisi e reportistica che consentono le decisioni di gestione del portafoglio e del ciclo di vita basate sui dati.

• Analizzare le prestazioni del portafoglio, gli sviluppi del mercato e i dati del ciclo di vita per identificare opportunità, rischi e aree di miglioramento.

• Sostenere le iniziative strategiche di Product Management e contribuire alla continua evoluzione della funzione Gestione Prodotto Gruppo.

Chi sei

• Istruzione formale nella gestione dei prodotti o una disciplina correlata, completata da una vasta esperienza pratica nel settore.

• Rilevato record in Product Management e Leadership ruoli all'interno di ambienti industriali, B2B, elettronica, HVAC o simili, con ampia esposizione nel ciclo di vita del prodotto.

• Forte comprensione dei prodotti hardware e software e delle sfide di gestione dei prodotti durante il loro ciclo di vita.

• Provato esperienza leader cambiamento organizzativo, adozione di guida, e con successo implementare nuovi standard, processi e modi di lavoro.

• Passione per lo sviluppo delle persone, la costruzione di capacità organizzative e la formazione di altri per raggiungere il successo sostenibile.

• mentalità analitica e sistemica combinata con un approccio pragmatico, orientato all'esecuzione e la capacità di tradurre i concetti in azione.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e incoraggiano nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, stanno rivoluzionando l'industria HVAC. Investire nella nostra gente è al centro dell'approccio di Belimo a coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per crescere un'azienda leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.

Was du tun wirst

• Eigene und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des globalen Produktmanagement-Trainingsprogramms von Belimo, um ein messbares Kapazitätswachstum und geschäftliche Auswirkungen im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

• Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung von KPI-Frameworks, Analysen und Berichtsstrukturen, die datengesteuerte Portfolio- und Lifecycle-Management-Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

• Analysieren Sie Portfolio-Performance, Marktentwicklungen und Lebenszyklusdaten, um Chancen, Risiken und Verbesserungsbereiche zu identifizieren.

• Analytische und systemorientierte Denkweise kombiniert mit einem pragmatischen, umsetzungsorientierten Ansatz und der Fähigkeit, Konzepte in die Tat umzusetzen.

jobs.title: Senior Model-Based System Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Summary

As the Senior Model-Based Systems Engineer, you will shape and drive the MBSE journey within R&D by defining methodologies, maintaining the systems engineering ontology, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and enabling teams to adopt best practices across the product development lifecycle. This is a highly influential role combining strategy, governance, methodology development, toolchain ownership, and coaching.

What You'll Do

• Act as the senior subject matter expert for MBSE across Innovation (R&D).

• Define and drive MBSE best practices, standards, and methodologies throughout development projects.

• Own and continuously improve the MBSE ontology, ensuring complete traceability across development artifacts.

• Monitor compliance with MBSE principles and track KPIs to drive continuous improvement.

• Support methodology owners in developing, aligning, and enhancing engineering methodologies.

• Develop and maintain templates, standards, and documentation within the MBSE tool environment.

• Manage and enhance MBSE tools (e.g., iQuavis), including processes, integrations, licensing, testing, and validation.

• Deliver training, coaching, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to ensure sustainable MBSE adoption.

Who You Are

• MSc degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Several years of hands-on experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), ideally within embedded systems development.

• Proven experience designing and implementing systems engineering processes and methodologies from the ground up.

• Strong understanding of modular systems and product-line engineering across multiple product families.

• Experience with MBSE tools, toolchain integration, automation, APIs, scripting, and reporting.

• Knowledge of adjacent disciplines such as Product Line Engineering (MBPLE) and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

• Systems Engineering certification is an advantage.

• Winning mindset, resilience, strong stakeholder management skills, excellent communication abilities, and a structured, data-driven approach to decision-making.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

jobs.description:
Summary

Drive innovation in HVAC and Building Automation by turning great ideas into impactful solutions. In this role, you connect technology, market trends and internal stakeholders to shape the next generation of products and applications.

What You'll Do

• Support exploration and innovation projects with deep HVAC and Building Automation expertise.

• Manage the intake and evaluation of product ideas submitted via the Idea Portal.

• Engage with idea originators to fully understand the idea, its purpose, and the underlying customer problem.

• Organize and facilitate ad-hoc cross-functional teams to assess, refine, and mature ideas.

• Prepare and deliver compelling idea pitches to relevant business units for decisions and next steps.

• Stay up to date on emerging HVAC and Building Automation applications, technologies, and industry trends.

• Act as an internal advocate for promising ideas through inspiring communication and internal marketing.

• Foster an innovation culture by building consensus, securing support, and keeping idea generators informed.

Who You Are

• University or university of applied sciences degree in a relevant technical field.

• Several years of appied professional experience in the HVAC and Building Automation industry, e.g in system integration or HVAC planning & engineering.

• Strong self-management skills with the ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks.

• Proactive, initiative-driven approach and structured, process-oriented work style.

• Strong analytical, conceptual, and commercial thinking abilities.

• High commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

• Fluent English

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

• Università o università di laurea in scienze applicate in un campo tecnico rilevante.
